text: Limited warranty. The DS-100 dock door sensor is warranted against defects in materials and workmanship for a period of three years from the date of shipment. Batteries are warranted for one year. The warranty covers repair or replacement at the manufacturer's choice.
Q: What are the payment terms? A: Standard accounts pay on net 30 terms. Enterprise accounts usually pay on net 45 terms set in their contract.

Delivery times: standard ground delivery takes three to five business days within the continental service area. Expedited delivery takes two business days. Freight deliveries are scheduled with the customer within one business day of the order being packed.

Claims. To make a claim, contact Larkspur support with the serial number and a description of the fault. A replacement unit ships within five business days of claim approval. Replaced units become the property of the manufacturer.
Q: How long does a return take? A: Most returns are inspected within five business days of reaching the warehouse.

Lost or damaged shipments: report damage within five days of delivery with photos of the carton and the item. We send replacements once the carrier claim is opened; customers do not need to wait for the claim to close.

To request a standard refund, open a billing ticket from the Invoices page of the Larkspur Portal and attach the invoice number. Hardware must come back in its original packaging with all accessories, cables and mounting brackets. Our warehouse inspects returned items within five business days. If an item arrives damaged because it was packed badly, we may deduct a restocking fee of up to 15 percent of the item price.

This policy explains how Larkspur Supply Co. handles refunds for hardware orders and Larkspur Portal subscriptions. Standard customers may request a refund within 30 days of delivery. The refund policy does NOT apply to enterprise contracts. Enterprise customers who want money back must raise a billing dispute with their account manager, who reviews it within ten business days and answers in writing.
Q: Why was I charged a late fee? A: Invoices unpaid 15 days after the due date carry a late fee of 1.5 percent per month.

Refunds go back to the original payment method. Card refunds usually appear within seven business days. Purchase-order customers receive a credit note that can be applied to their next invoice. Gift cards and promotional credits cannot be converted to cash.

Exclusions. The warranty does not cover damage from forklift impact, improper mounting, water ingress caused by removing the gasket, or use outside the rated temperature range of minus 30 to plus 60 degrees Celsius.

Order processing: orders are picked in the order they are received. Orders that need custom cutting or engraving add three business days. Back-ordered items ship separately at no extra cost, and the Portal shows a revised date for each line.
Q: Do you ship on weekends? A: No. Orders are picked and shipped on business days only.
Same-day shipping: orders for in-stock items placed before 2 p.m. Central time on a business day ship the same day; orders placed later ship the next business day.
Shipping costs: parcel shipping is free on orders over $500. Freight is quoted per order based on weight and distance. Remote and island addresses may carry a surcharge, shown before checkout.
